{"id":1986452208,"question_id":2721,"lang":"cpp","lang_name":"C++","time":"2 months, 4 weeks","timestamp":1776970650,"status":10,"status_display":"Accepted","runtime":"72 ms","url":"/submissions/detail/1986452208/","is_pending":"Not Pending","title":"Sum of Distances","memory":"123.3 MB","code":"class Solution {\npublic:\n    using ll = long long; \n    vector<long long> distance(vector<int>& nums) {\n        unordered_map<ll , vector<ll>>mp;\n\n        for(int i = 0 ; i<nums.size() ; i++) mp[nums[i]].push_back(i);\n\n        vector<long long>ans(nums.size() , 0);\n        for(auto &it : mp)\n        {\n            auto vec = it.second;\n            int m = vec.size();\n            if(m == 1) continue;\n\n            vector<ll>pref(m , 0);\n            pref[0] = vec[0];\n            \n            for(int i = 1 ; i<m ; i++) pref[i] = pref[i-1] + vec[i];\n            \n            ll total = pref[m-1];\n            for(int i = 0 ; i<m ; i++)\n            {\n                ll leftSum = 0;\n                if(i > 0) leftSum = pref[i - 1];\n\n                ll rightSum = total - pref[i];\n\n                ll left = (vec[i] * i) - leftSum;\n                ll right = rightSum - (vec[i] * (m - i - 1));\n\n                ans[vec[i]] = left + right;\n            }\n        }\n        return ans;\n    }\n};","compare_result":"","title_slug":"sum-of-distances","has_notes":false,"flag_type":1,"frontend_id":1934}
